job.job_description:
About Us:

Solytics Partners is a Global Analytics firm, recognized with multiple industry awards for innovation and excellence. Our team comprises experts with deep knowledge in risk, analytics, AI/ML, AML/FCC, and fraud. By converging this expertise with cutting-edge technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs), we deliver powerful automated platforms and incisive point solutions. Our offerings enable clients to streamline and future-proof their risk, AML, and analytics processes, comply seamlessly with global regulations, and safeguard financial systems. Whether its solving complex challenges or driving operational efficiency, Solytics Partners is committed to empowering organizations with transformative tools to stay ahead in an evolving regulatory landscape.




Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly motivated AI Engineer with 0 - 2 years of experience to join our dynamic AI & Data Science team. You will work on building and operationalizing machine learning and AI models that power next-generation solutions in risk analytics, financial crime detection, model governance, and regulatory compliance. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, domain experts, and product teams to design scalable, production-ready AI systems.




Key Responsibilities:

Model Development & Research: Design, develop, and validate ML/AI models for use cases such as anomaly detection, fraud detection, risk scoring, and predictive analytics. Research and prototype new algorithms to improve performance, robustness, and explainability.




Productionization: Lead model deployment, monitoring, and scaling on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure). Integrate models into application pipelines and data workflows.




Data & Feature Engineering: Work with large, complex datasets; perform cleaning, transformation, feature extraction, and feature selection. Collaborate with data engineering to optimize data pipelines.




Model Lifecycle & Governance: Support model versioning, testing, validation, and documentation to meet internal and regulatory standards.

Implement monitoring for model drift, performance degradation, and bias detection.




Collaboration & Communication: Partner with domain experts in financial risk, AML, compliance, and business stakeholders to align AI solutions with business needs.

Present insights, findings, and technical recommendations to cross-functional teams.




Key Requirements & Technical Skills:

0-2 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering or relevant data science roles.
Strong command of Python and ML/AI libraries (e.g., Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Proven experience in building and deploying ML models in production.
Experience with cloud computing (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Docker, Kubernetes.
Working knowledge of data processing frameworks (e.g., SQL, Spark).



AI/ML Expertise:

Solid understanding of statistical learning, supervised/unsupervised learning, and deep learning.
Experience with model interpretability and explainability frameworks.



Soft Skills:

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communicator capable of collaborating across technical and business teams.
